title: Slow English Daily Routine ☀️ | Real-Life Comprehensible Input
channel: Speak English with Bo's Slow English

lines.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to a new episode
of Bo's Slow English. Before I give you
an update on my life, I wanted to share
this delicious dessert that I found at
the grocery store. It's called a raw
black bottom banana cream pie.
It's raw. So, what does that mean? It
means that it is not cooked and there is
no heat used to make this recipe. It is
a black bottom type cake. I'm not sure
why it's called black bottom cake
because the very bottom,
as you can see from the side, is not
black. But, there is a dark layer close
to the bottom. So, I guess that is why
it's called black bottom.
And then we have the banana cream pie.
So, there is banana and coconut cream, a
little bit of coconut sugar.
On top is a drizzle of chocolate. It's
so good.
Bon appetit.
I've decided to move over to my dining
room area. I felt much more comfortable
to sit down and chat with you. I just
quit my full-time job. So, for the next
few months, I will be focusing on
YouTube until I figure out what I will
be doing full-time again. I would really
like to stress the importance of saving
money. I'm going to have a new daily
routine for the next few months. I am
still going to wake up early around
to
a.m. I always take my morning
medication and I'm not allowed to eat
anything for 30 minutes after taking the
medication. While I wait for my
medication to settle, I make my
husband's breakfast. He eats a very
light breakfast. It's two strips of
turkey bacon. I cook or I fry the turkey
bacon in a pan. I will cook one side for
about 4 to 5 minutes, then I will flip
it to the other side and cook for an
additional 4 to 5 minutes so that it is
nice and crispy. My husband also likes
to drink green tea or matcha
specifically. So, I make him matcha in
the morning as well. Then, I will take
my dog out for her first morning walk.
She does her business outside. When you
hear someone say business, what they
mean is the dog is going to the
bathroom. I will walk Nari around the
block. Every time Nari goes outside and
comes back in, I will wipe her paws.
Now, it is time to make breakfast for
Nari and Louie, my cat. Now, it is time
for me to make my breakfast. I will make
two to three eggs over medium, which
means that the yolk is a little runny,
but a little bit hard, so it's medium.
Then, I will sprinkle some salt and
pepper and cut up the eggs before I eat
it.
I only drink coffee one day per week or
one cup per week. I never crave coffee.
I like to do my workouts in the morning.
Sometimes, we have cardio days, which
means that we are strengthening our
cardiovascular
system, our heart. Sometimes, we will do
strength training. If I do not go to the
gym, I might go to yoga or I might go to
Pilates. After I finish lunch, I will do
the dishes and put my silverware and
plate away. Then, I will spend about an
hour and a half editing a video. After
my editing session, I will start to
think of what to film. Today, I'm going
to make meatballs in the air fryer. When
we cook at home, we keep it very simple.
It's always rice,
broccoli, and some sort of protein. The
other day, we did salmon and today will
be meatballs. After I've finished all of
my meetings and have eaten dinner and
edited, it is time to veg out or become
a couch potato,
which basically means you sit on the
couch and you don't do anything but
watch TV. Lately, I've been watching
some Korean shows to help me to brush up
on my Korean. Brush up is a phrasal
verb, which means that you are
relearning something. I love the show
Physical 100, which is a reality
competition show all about strength and
power. I love watching top athletes
perform. I also really love to watch
true crime documentaries.
I find it to be really fascinating
and some people might find it to be
scary because of these real-life
situations, but I just absolutely love
it. Then, I will do my nighttime
routine, which involves taking some
supplements such as magnesium
to help my body and my mind to relax
before I go to bed and I will brush my
teeth, floss my teeth, wash my face, and
put all of my skin care products on, and
finally, I am in bed. So, that is my new
daily routine since I have quit my
full-time job and I'm focusing on
YouTube for the next couple of months
until I pick up another full-time job. I
hope you learned some useful and new
vocabulary words from this video. Let me
know in the comments what you've learned
and I will see you in the next video.
Bye.
